name: DomainRAG
description: DomainRAG is a Chinese benchmark designed to evaluate domain-specific retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) models in the context of college enrollment. It assesses six key abilities including conversational RAG, structural information analysis, faithfulness to external knowledge, denoising, solving time-sensitive problems, and multi-document interaction understanding.
reputation: A recent Chinese RAG benchmark with growing interest for domain-specific retrieval and generation evaluation, but still limited in adoption outside its target setting.
notes: Focuses on expert and domain-specific applications with shared corpora for evaluating multiple abilities.
